# ARC-0005 · Toolkit crashes on the first launch, works on the second

**Goal:** the Toolkit opens the Arcana project on the first try.
**Intent:** the Owner stops paying a crash per launch after every update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The one data error the engine reports for the mod is fixed: `COMPREHEND_SUPERNATURAL` `AuraStatuses` has
      `ApplyStatus(DETECT_SUPERNATURAL_ABERRATION,100,_1)` — `_1` must be `-1` (log: `failed to parse stats expression
      string "_1"`), in the game `.txt` and the Toolkit `.stats`.
- [x] Owner test: open the Toolkit, close it normally, open it again — 4 launches, no crash (2026-10-12).

## Findings (2026-10-12)

- Every crash today (12:26, 12:54, 13:15, 14:51, 15:30, 15:48 local) has the same stack: `ls::anubis::System::LoadFramework`
  → `TreeRef::UpdateExpressions` → `ls::khonsu::Machine::FindScript` → read access violation. It is preceded in
  `log.*.txt` by four `!CRITICAL! Double delete detected` (`BlocksAllocator<64>::Free`, Noesis UI teardown) at the
  client state swap to `LoadSession`: memory is freed twice, then the AI framework load reads it.
- The crashing and the working session load exactly the same data up to that point (normalised logs identical,
  same 22 design asserts). So the data is not what differs between them.
- Not every update is followed by a crash (14:02, the first launch after stage 3, opened fine), and 15:48 crashed
  with no change to the mod since the last good session. Every crash was followed by a working launch within a
  minute; launches after a normal close usually crashed.
- Toolkit binaries unchanged since 2026-07-31; the mod's Khonsu helpers unchanged since 2026-10-07.
- The `_1` typo predates the project migration (2026-10-11), so it cannot be what made the crash frequent; it is
  fixed because it is the only data error the engine reports for the mod, and a failed parse is a plausible source
  of a bad pointer.

## Log

- 2026-10-12 — investigated (read only): crash dumps, `errors.*`, `log.*`, Story, editor settings. Ticket created.
- 2026-10-12 — `[fechado]`: `_1` → `-1` in `COMPREHEND_SUPERNATURAL` (game .txt and Toolkit .stats, one occurrence each; entry counts unchanged); selftest 992/0, check_cards OK. Waiting for the Owner's open/close/open test.
- 2026-10-12 — three more crashes (launch, Reload Story after a clean compile — 0 errors —, launch). Full stack from `log.*`: the double delete happens inside `ls::FileManager::OpenFile` called by `ls::khonsu::Machine::FindScript` during the Anubis load — Khonsu opening a script file from disk. `[fechado]`: the nine one-function helpers merged into `Scripts/thoth/helpers/ArcanaHelpers.khn` (9 of 9 bodies identical; originals in `90_ARCHIVE/93_Old_Versions/2026-10-12_ARC-0005_khn_merged`). Waiting for the Owner's open/close test.
- 2026-10-12 — **fixed.** After the nine Khonsu helpers were merged into `ArcanaHelpers.khn`, the Owner opened the Toolkit 4 times without a crash (it crashed on most launches before). So the trigger was the mod's loose one-function `.khn` files being opened during the AI load (the Toolkit's file cache double-freed under that load) — not the data in them, and not unrelated to the mod as first thought. Rule kept: helpers live in ONE file. Done.
tickets.title: Toolkit crashes on the first launch, works on the second

The Kingmaker audit goes with its 05 handoff. - [x] Handoffs for the Kingmaker: Context Keeper (`05.02` + Depth audit, `05.00`, `05.06`), Lore Writer (`31.01`), Localization (`33.03`); `21.08` Kingmaker column with Axis = Balance; `10.06` updated. - [x] Every gap resolved by a decision in `21.04/Kingmaker/DECISIONS.md` (SP47–SP103) or listed as open (spec §14). - [x] Raising spec written: `21.04/Kingmaker/DESIGN.md` (§1.5 sections, Identity Sheet complete, no audit inside). - [x] Balance pass: numbers in `25.01`–`25.02` (11 SPL, 6 FEAT), arithmetic in `22.05/2026-10-13_ARC-0008_Kingmaker_Balance.md` (approved). ## Gates - [x] Design gate (`21.04/_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` §15) — answered 2026-10-13, passes with three notes (below) - [x] Narrative gate (`32.04`) — passed 2026-10-15, recorded in `32.04/ARC-0008_Kingmaker.md` (second sentence, panel line, tag line, *Fortune's Reach*, 52 tooltips) - [ ] DoD (`00.03`) ### Design gate (2026-10-13) Answered by the main session in the roles the standard names. | # | Question | Answer | |---|---|---| | 1 | Pillar and fantasy (Lead Class Designer) | `21.01` (Vision and Pillars) **does not exist yet**; checked against the class pillars in `31.01` §1 — **Tarot**: the Rota Fortunae read literally; **Mystra and the Weave**: SP95's sentence, Atropos cuts the thread; **Destiny at level 1**: own chassis (CHA, Courtier, Sorcerer voice). Fantasy *"I don't win fights. I decide who does."* is what the kit does (SP97) | | 2 | Role without duplication, `21.08` (Lead Class Designer) | Force multiplier, axis **Balance** (free). Note: the role sits close to the Resonant's (support through states); different axis (Balance vs Combination); the class's magical-DPR gap is a future ticket (`10.06`) | | 3 | Resource and recharge, `26` (Spell Designer) | Woven Spell Slots / Threads for the cards (Long Rest / per turn); Turn the Spoke no slot (Bonus Action); Peripeteia, Usurp, Rota Fortunae once per combat; The Wheel Stops and the Master of Coin once per Long Rest; the Court is named once per Long Rest. The Wheel itself costs nothing | | 4 | Power on the curve, `22` (Balance Designer) | ≈ 88 % of the budget per turn at T1 (no Court yet), ≈ 92 % at T2, ≈ 95–100 % at T3 counting the tiers and the capstone (`22.05` §6); leans weak early, on purpose | | 5 | One tooltip read; complexity budget (Lead Class Designer) | The core rule fits one passive (The Rota); a new player can name the signature (the Wheel, the Crossing) after one fight. **11 combat actions** against the standard's suggested 3 (suggestion until an ADR); one main resource (positions) and one secondary (the Court, set before battle) | | 6 | Interactions (Balance Designer) | No Concentration in the kit; Coronation and Turn the Spoke share the Bonus Action (a choice); one position per creature, Advantage sources don't stack (SP52); Crossing once per enemy per round; Hubris consumed; Nemesis moves only Falling enemies; Master of Coin once per Long Rest — no open loop | | 7 | Core 1–12 without 13–20 (Validator) | Complete at 12 (capstone 11, Tier III 12); nothing depends on 13–20 | | 8 | Intent in one sentence (Spell Designer) | *The Kingmaker makes the party stronger by keeping allies at the top of Fortune's Wheel while enemies hit the bottom — and every fall beside a reign hurts.* | **Notes:** (1) `21.01` has to be written (pillars for the whole class) — proposal for the Owners; (2) the complexity budget is above the suggestion until an ADR fixes it; (3) the T1/T3 percentages are rough and go to the playtest. ## Log - 2026-10-08 — design conversation (before the project migration): `21.04/Spinner/2026-10-08-spinner-design.md`. - 2026-10-13 — created; decisions SP1–SP43 recorded from that conversation; audit against the current §3 done and handed to the Context Keeper. Gaps to brainstorm, in order: **K3 ultimate** (and A3), the **complexity budget** (§15: ~25 combat actions), then I6 names, W1, D1/D2; balance pass after. - 2026-10-13 — three alternative proposals for the raise (A Measured Thread · B Rise and Fall · C Fortuna's Wager) in `93/2026-10-15_Kingmaker_raise_proposals/2026-10-13-spinner-three-proposals.md`; awaiting the Owner's choice (SP47). - 2026-10-13 — brainstorm with the Owner: direction B *Rise and Fall* chosen, subclass renamed **The Kingmaker**; decisions SP47–SP71 (Wheel positions, King/Regent, the Court/Small Council, verbs, Crossing, Cut, Peripeteia, The Wheel Stops, chassis, progression). Next: Hubris fix, Awakening, card details, edge cases, raising spec. - 2026-10-13 — SP72 (Hubris: who reigned falls harder). The old Spinner audit handoff, never applied, archived in `90/93/2026-10-13_ARC-0008_spinner_audit` (design replaced by the Kingmaker); the Kingmaker gets its own audit with the raising spec. Owner's note: the Kingmaker's role sits close to the Resonant's (support through states) and the mod still lacks a magical burst/DPR subclass — a future tarot card will fill that gap (not this ticket). - 2026-10-13 — brainstorm closed: SP72–SP103 (Hubris, Succession, Awakening Tyche/Nemesis/Aspect of Anticipation, Usurp, Foreseen, card details, edge cases, Identity Sheet, names, Osiris drives the Wheel). # ARC-0009 · Create the Lionheart (was the Titan) to the subclass standard (design)

**Goal:** design the Lionheart — tarot **VIII · Strength**, the slot the game still calls *Titan* — from the
evaluation questions of `_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` to a raising spec, the same path the Resonant (ARC-0002) and
the Kingmaker (ARC-0008) took.
**Intent:** the Lionheart replaces the placeholder copy of the Resonant level-1 kit with a kit of its own, so
the subclass plays its own fantasy from level 1.

## Where the work goes

The design runs in a separate cloud session (Owner, 2026-10-14). When it is finished, that session commits and
pushes with this ticket's id first in every commit message, and updates:

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Brainstorm decisions (one id per answer, `LH1`…) | `50_ENGINEERING/55_Implementation_Specs/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md` |
| Raising spec (§1–15 of the standard) | `20_GAME_DESIGN/21_GDD_Arcana_Class/21.04_Subclasses/Lionheart/` (folder exists, empty) |
| Player-facing texts (draft until the Narrative gate) | `50_ENGINEERING/55_Implementation_Specs/_wip/Lionheart/texts.md` |
| Numbers (ADR-0005: only here) | `20_GAME_DESIGN/25_Master_Data/25.01…` (`SPL_Lionheart_*`), `25.02…` (`FEAT_Lionheart_*`) |
| Balance pass | `20_GAME_DESIGN/22_Balance_DnD5e/22.05_Balance_Reports/` |
| Role and axis column | `20_GAME_DESIGN/21_GDD_Arcana_Class/21.08_Subclass_Matrix.md` |
| Handoffs (Context Keeper, Lore Writer, Localization) | the receiving department's folder, `HANDOFF_LeadClassDesigner_to_<Role>_ARC-0009.md` |
| Implementation spec and Toolkit entry guide | `55/SPEC_ARC-0009.md`, `55/TOOLKIT_ARC-0009.md` (from `_TEMPLATE_TOOLKIT_GUIDE.md`) |
| Ticket progress | this file (criteria, gates, log); then `perl 80_TOOLS_AND_PIPELINE/82_Automation/update_board.pl` |

**Already in the game, not committed yet (Owner, Toolkit, 2026-10-14):** tag `2a90eb1d…` renamed THETITAN →
THELIONHEART, `EQP_CC_Lionheart` in `Equipment.stats`, the class name handle `ha017a8f9…` = "The Lionheart". The
ProgressionDescription still reads *Titan*. They are synced to `51` and wait for this ticket's first commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every evaluative question of §3 answered for the Lionheart.
- [ ] Every Owner decision recorded in `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md`; open points listed in the spec.
- [ ] Raising spec written in `21.04/Lionheart/` (§1.5 sections, Identity Sheet complete).
- [ ] Role and axis in `21.08` without duplicating another subclass (note: the class lacks a magical burst/DPR subclass — `10.06`, ARC-0008).
- [ ] Balance pass: numbers in `25.01`–`25.02`, arithmetic in `22.05`.
- [ ] Handoffs sent (Context Keeper `05.02/Lionheart.md`, Lore Writer, Localization).
- [ ] `SPEC_ARC-0009` and `TOOLKIT_ARC-0009` written for the Owner's Toolkit entry.

## Gates

- [ ] Design gate (`21.04/_SUBCLASS_STANDARD.md` §15)
- [ ] Narrative gate (`32.04`)
- [ ] DoD (`00.03`)

## Log

- 2026-10-14 — created (Owner request during ARC-0008). Design in a separate cloud session; the Toolkit changes
  above stay out of the ARC-0008 commit.
- 2026-10-14 — brainstorm (cloud session): direction **D · Two Hands, One Foe** chosen over A–C and E–F;
  decisions LH1–LH19 in `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md` (Aspect of Courage, the Villain by highest maximum HP,
  One Labour at a Time, Stand Before the Beast, cards as Lion / Maiden containers, Finisher, Fang and Shield,
  Strength secondary). Next: chassis (saves, armour, weapons, skills), progression, Awakening, pool.
- 2026-10-15 — brainstorm continued in the cloud session up to LH61 (chassis, Awakening, ultimate, capstone
  *Lion's Judgement*, full 1–12 progression, form dice and defences). Hand-off to the Claude Desktop session:
  open questions, T2 checks and next topics at the end of `55/_wip/Lionheart/decisions.md`.
- 2026-10-17 — Propagated (00.08) by ARC-0027 in each role: decisions and texts moved out of `55/_wip` (`21.04/Lionheart/DECISIONS.md`, `32.01/Lionheart.md`), design renamed `DESIGN.md`; `21.03`, `21.08` column, 15 sheets in `23.02/Lionheart/`, `22.05` (no balance pass yet) and `26.01`, `31.01` rows (Titan → Lionheart), `31.02`, `33.03` terms, `42.04`, `61.02/Lionheart/TC_ARC-0009.md`, `05.02` with the Depth audit, `05.00`, README. Still due (work flow stage 3): the Owner's design review, then the balance pass (`25`, `22.05`).
- 2026-10-17 — ARC-0027 (Producer, phase D): stage 3 — design written and propagated; waiting for the Owner's design review, then the balance pass.

# ARC-0011 · Resonant: two descriptions behind the mechanic

**Goal:** fix the English of Emotional Contagion (only the target's allies catch the mood, R35) and Emotional Overload (the meter is not per fight, R31).

**Decision it informs:** close the ARC-0019 build, or send a failing rule back to the Lead Class Designer; part A also
decides whether the Veil build (DV1–DV17) is sound enough to build on.
**Scenario:** console edition (no SE), a Deceiver built through the real progression, the standard saves of `83.02`;
the PC (SE) edition where marked. Compile the Story after any apply. Values: `25` (`*_Deceiver_*`).

#### A · The Veil build, untested since 2026-10-07 (`05.02` §8) — runnable today

| # | Rule | Expected | Plan B if not |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | The Doubles' spells follow her tier (the shapeshift rule switch) | Level 1–4: Splinter + Dismiss only · 5: + Mirror: Sigil and Mirror: Chains · 9: + Unveil | The goal re-applies the rule on level-up |
| A2 | Mirror damage is half her card at her highest slot (DV17) | Level 5 (slot 3): Mirror: Sigil deals (3d6)/2 Force and lays her Sigil | Fixed variants per slot band |
| A3 | Veiled Prison saves with Disadvantage at 2+ Doubt | Doubt 2 → the save shows Disadvantage; Doubt 1 → normal | — |
| A4 | Grand Deception fills the cap and gives Doubt on a failed save | Doubles up to the cap; each failing enemy within 9 m gains 2 Doubt (1 → Deluded at 3) | — |
| A5 | Awakening steps count Doubt stacks | Goals 4 / 7 / 10 count down on the progress status; each tier wakes at its goal | — |
| A6 | Two Pillars (Tier II) | Once per turn, a Deluded enemy in her name seeds the nearest unmarked enemy within 6 m | — |
| A7 | Which One? (Tier III): whose Doubt | The attacker gains Doubt **in her name** (counts for her Awakening) | Raise it through the Doubt goal with her as the cause |
| A8 | The Veil Lifts makes every Double cast Shatter off its turn | Every Double bursts; every Sigil of hers detonates; survivors with Doubt become Deluded | Explode at each Double's position from Osiris |

#### B · Probes for the ARC-0019 build (one rule each — run first, they decide the spec)

| # | Rule | Expected | Plan B if not |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | The Tier III burst on death (DV21, vanilla Death Burst pattern) | A Double destroyed by an enemy explodes at its last position with the wider radius; the Doubt is hers | A Splinter cast by Osiris at the Double's position before it is removed |
| B2 | Only the "destroyed by an enemy" path bursts (DESIGN §4.8) | Dismiss, the cap, combat end, an ally's spell, her death: **no** burst, no Doubt | Tag the cleanup paths before the Double dies |
| B3 | Splinter on Command (DV24, DV31) picks one Double | The chosen Double splinters now; bonus action spent; no slot; on PC it costs Threads and is drawn from the deck (DV32) | Target the Double with the spell |
| B4 | Grand Deception counts Doubles near each enemy **before** the new ones appear (DV22) (SPEC_ARC-0020 probe B5) | Doubt per enemy = Doubles within 3 m of it before the cast (`25` `doubles_range_next`) | Snapshot the Doubles' positions on cast |
| B8 | At Tier III the Splinter shout deals nothing itself; the 4 m burst does (SPEC_ARC-0020 probe B6) | One damage number per enemy per Splinter, 4 m reach | A Tier III shapeshift rule with a damage-free Splinter |
| B5 | The level map (DV28) | `dump_progression.pl`: the rows of DESIGN §9.1, levels 4 and 8 empty, no Telepathy | — |
| B6 | One visible passive (DV19) | The Veil states the core rule; no *Doubt* passive in the list | — |
| B7 | Names (DV29) | Every name in `32.01/Deceiver.md` "after the build"; no Sigil, Shatter, Mirror Image, Distortion, Ethereal Chains or Mimic in a tooltip | — |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V1 | Level 2, any | Turns where Splinter on Command is used | Used in most fights, not every turn | Never used, or used every turn (dominant) | DV24 |
| V1b | Level 2, PC | Share of turns Splinter on Command is in hand when a Double is on the field | Often enough to plan around (DM-P12) | Rarely in hand when it matters | DV32 |

# QA_ARC-0008 · The Kingmaker — new subclass (levels 1–12)

**Goal:** play every test, level by level, and mark it on Arcana Test Guides (https://claude.ai/artifact/3us5sESX9EbPDksY6H7W1E);
results come back here at `/sync-test-guides`. **Intent:** ARC-0008 is proven in the game, or each failure becomes a fix (bug) or
a decision (design feedback, OR-1). One file per ARC (OR-4): merged on 2026-10-17 from QA-0002, GUIDE_ARC-0008, TC_ARC-0008.

## Before you start

- Compile the Story in the Toolkit and check log.txt: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).
- Use a new Kingmaker built through the real progression, in a party of four.
- Console edition. The PC deck is not built yet (SPEC stage 7).
- Known, not a test: the subclass icon in character creation is still the Spinner one (SPEC stage 7).

## Level 1 — The Wheel: Coronation, Dethrone, Turn the Spoke, the cantrip

**Setup:** A Kingmaker at level 1, in a party of four, a normal fight.

### L1.1 · Coronation on an ally

- **Rule:** P1 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Coronation on an ally
- **Expected:** It shows Rising (+3 m, can't be Prone)
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.2 · Dethrone on an enemy, then a save success on another

- **Rule:** P2 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Dethrone on an enemy, then a save success on another
- **Expected:** Damage (half on the save) and Falling on both
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.3 · Spoke of the Wheel on a Fallen enemy vs a normal one

- **Rule:** P8 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Spoke of the Wheel on a Fallen enemy vs a normal one
- **Expected:** The extra 1d4 shows only on the Falling / Fallen target
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.4 · End the turn; at your next turn start

- **Rule:** P3 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** End the turn; at your next turn start
- **Expected:** Ally → Reigning and King; enemy → Fallen; the change shows before you act, with you as the source (tooltip)
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.5 · Turn the Spoke on the Falling enemy

- **Rule:** P5 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Turn the Spoke on the Falling enemy
- **Expected:** It drops to Fallen at once; no slot spent
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.6 · Be downed with creatures on the Wheel

- **Rule:** P6 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Be downed with creatures on the Wheel
- **Expected:** The Wheel still turns at your turn start (SP90); plan B: Osiris drives the turn from the next creature's `TurnStarted`
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.7 · Kill a creature on the Wheel; end combat

- **Rule:** P7 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Kill a creature on the Wheel; end combat
- **Expected:** The dead one leaves the Wheel; at combat end every position status is gone
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L1.8 · Crown two allies on different turns

- **Rule:** P4 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Crown two allies on different turns
- **Expected:** When both Reign, the older one is King, the other Regent
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

## Level 3 — The Crossing, Awakening Tier I Tyche, Atropos' Cut

**Setup:** A Kingmaker at level 3, in a party of four, a normal fight.

### L3.1 · Level 3: Coronation on an ally, Dethrone on an enemy within 9 m of ...

- **Rule:** P9 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Level 3: Coronation on an ally, Dethrone on an enemy within 9 m of it; end the turn
- **Expected:** At your turn start the ally Reigns and the enemy, Fallen, shows The Crossing and takes 1d4 Force from you (combat log) | No damage: `Cause.` not resolved from Osiris → three statuses with fixed dice, chosen by `GetLevel`
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.2 · Same, with the enemy more than 9 m from the ally

- **Rule:** P10 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Same, with the enemy more than 9 m from the ally
- **Expected:** Fallen, no Crossing | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.3 · Two Reigning allies next to one enemy entering Fallen; then Turn th...

- **Rule:** P11 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Two Reigning allies next to one enemy entering Fallen; then Turn the Spoke it round to Fallen again in the same round
- **Expected:** One Crossing only, both times | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.4 · Fight with one enemy on the Wheel, then two

- **Rule:** P12 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Fight with one enemy on the Wheel, then two
- **Expected:** The Awakening counts 2 per Crossing with one enemy, 1 with two; 3 Crossings awaken Tyche (status, card *Rota Fortunae* in the hotbar) | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.5 · With Tyche: Coronation, then Dethrone next to the Reigning ally

- **Rule:** P13 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** With Tyche: Coronation, then Dethrone next to the Reigning ally
- **Expected:** The ally enters Reigning (King at once); the enemy enters Fallen and crosses at once | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.6 · Rota Fortunae

- **Rule:** P14 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Rota Fortunae
- **Expected:** Every creature on the Wheel moves one step; a Falling enemy near a Reigning ally crosses; it can't be cast again this combat | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.7 · Atropos' Cut on a Fallen, a Falling and a Rising enemy (one each)

- **Rule:** P15 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Atropos' Cut on a Fallen, a Falling and a Rising enemy (one each)
- **Expected:** 3d8 / 2d8 / 1d8 Slashing; the enemy loses its position status and the Wheel ignores it | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L3.8 · Atropos' Cut on the Reigning King; then cast Dethrone and Atropos' ...

- **Rule:** P16 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Atropos' Cut on the Reigning King; then cast Dethrone and Atropos' Cut with a higher slot
- **Expected:** The ally leaves the Wheel, keeps *Reigning* until the end of its next turn, loses the crown; Dethrone at slot 2 shows 4d6, the Cut at slot 3 shows 4d8 / 3d8 / 2d8 | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

- **Rule:** P17 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Level 5, CHA 15 (+2): Convene the Court twice out of combat, then try a third
- **Expected:** Two offices land; the third option can't be cast (`COURT_FULL`); in combat the container can't be cast | `GetAbility` key not `"Charisma"` → read the modifier from a boost-free stat

- **Rule:** P19 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Appoint the Lord Commander next to the King

- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.

### L5.4 · Master of Healing heals a Fallen ally, then a Falling one

- **Rule:** P20 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Master of Healing heals a Fallen ally, then a Falling one
- **Expected:** Fallen → Rising at once; the Falling ally doesn't move | `OnHeal` doesn't fire from potions/items → note it
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L5.5 · Long Rest

- **Rule:** P21 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Long Rest
- **Expected:** Every office and `COURT_FULL` are gone; the options can be cast again | Statuses survive the rest → Osiris removes them at `LongRestFinished` (already written)
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L5.6 · A holder dies

- **Rule:** P22 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** A holder dies
- **Expected:** Its office ends; the seat isn't given back until the Long Rest | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L5.7 · Level 5 character: open Convene the Court

- **Rule:** P32 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Level 5 character: open Convene the Court
- **Expected:** Master of Laws and Master of Secrets are shown but can't be cast before level 7 | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L5.8 · Peripeteia with allies and enemies on the Wheel, some beyond 18 m

- **Rule:** P23 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Peripeteia with allies and enemies on the Wheel, some beyond 18 m
- **Expected:** Within 18 m: Reigning ↔ Fallen, Rising ↔ Falling; an enemy turned Fallen next to a Reigning ally crosses at once; beyond 18 m nothing moves | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L5.9 · Cast Peripeteia again in the same fight, with a higher slot

- **Rule:** P24 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Cast Peripeteia again in the same fight, with a higher slot
- **Expected:** It can't (once per combat, variants included) | Variants don't share the cooldown → a `PERIPETEIA_USED` status like `ARCANE_MASTERY_USED`
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

## Level 7 — Hubris, Usurp, Tier II Nemesis, two offices

**Setup:** A Kingmaker at level 7, in a party of four, a normal fight.

### L7.1 · With Nemesis (5 Crossings): a Hubris enemy crosses with a Falling e...

- **Rule:** P26 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** With Nemesis (5 Crossings): a Hubris enemy crosses with a Falling enemy within 3 m
- **Expected:** The Falling one drops to Fallen and crosses too if an ally Reigns near; nothing loops | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L7.2 · Master of Laws held; a Rising enemy attacks the King

- **Rule:** P29 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Master of Laws held; a Rising enemy attacks the King
- **Expected:** At the next turn it skips Reigning and lands on Falling (no Hubris) | `AttackedBy` doesn't fire on misses → note it
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L7.3 · Same with a Reigning enemy; with a Falling one

- **Rule:** P30 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Same with a Reigning enemy; with a Falling one
- **Expected:** Reigning → Fallen (and may cross); Falling → Fallen only | —
- **Fails if:** It does not happen as expected.
- **Result:** —

### L7.4 · Master of Secrets; an enemy on the Wheel within 9 m tries to hide o...

- **Rule:** P31 · SPEC_ARC-0008
- **Steps:** Master of Secrets; an enemy on the Wheel within 9 m tries to hide or turn invisible

- **Rule:** P39 · SPEC_ARC-0008

# QA_ARC-0017 · The Heartsong — refining R49–R68 (levels 1–12)

**Goal:** play every test, level by level, and mark it on Arcana Test Guides (https://claude.ai/artifact/3us5sESX9EbPDksY6H7W1E);
results come back here at `/sync-test-guides`. **Intent:** ARC-0017 is proven in the game, or each failure becomes a fix (bug) or
a decision (design feedback, OR-1). One file per ARC (OR-4): merged on 2026-10-17 from QA-0001, GUIDE_ARC-0017, TC_ARC-0014.

## Before you start

- Compile the Story in the Toolkit once: the Overload, Temperance and Shared Heart goals changed during the build.
- Use a NEW Resonant. A character from an older save already learned the eight emotions as separate spells.
- Console edition unless a test says PC. Read results in the combat log and on the status tooltips.
- Some texts of growing dice still say 1d4 (text pass ARC-0006): judge the dice by the combat log, not the tooltip.
- Not tested here: Releases per day (V7) and feelings at release on a boss (V6) are balance metrics: they run in ARC-0010.

## Level 1 — Weave Surge, Heartstring, Emotional Overload

**Setup:** A new Resonant at level 1, one ally, a normal fight against two or three enemies. Tests marked PC: the PC edition with the deck on.

### L1.1 · Weave Surge opens with the emotions you know

- **Rule:** B6a · R54
- **Steps:** Open the Weave Surge button on the hotbar.
- **Expected:** One button. Joy, Trust and Fear can be cast; the other five are greyed out or missing.
- **Fails if:** Eight separate buttons, all eight castable, or the container opens empty.
- **Plan B:** Grant each emotion in the level lists again and keep the container for the hotbar only.
- **Result:** —

### L1.2 · Emotional Overload is free

- **Rule:** B3a · R66
- **Steps:** Cast Surges until the Overload meter reaches 100%. Open Emotional Overload.
- **Expected:** Castable as a Bonus Action while Overloaded, with no spell slot spent. Only one version of it shows.
- **Fails if:** It asks for a slot, cannot be cast while Overloaded, or several level versions show.
- **Result:** —

### L1.3 · Overloaded is a trade, not a silence

- **Rule:** R51a · R51
- **Steps:** With the meter full, check the Overloaded status, then cast spells and wait for your next turn.
- **Expected:** You can still cast spells. 1d4 Psychic at the start of your turn. -1 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.
- **Fails if:** You are silenced, take no damage, or the save penalty is missing.
- **Result:** —

### L1.4 · The Surge rider, once per turn

- **Rule:** R51b · R51
- **Steps:** While Overloaded, land a Surge on an enemy (it fails its save), then land a second Surge the same turn.
- **Expected:** The first deals an extra 1d4 Psychic; the second deals none. The next turn it works again.
- **Fails if:** No extra damage, or extra damage on both Surges.
- **Result:** —

### L1.5 · Emotional Overload, rank I

- **Rule:** R51c · R51 R68
- **Steps:** Braid a feeling on an enemy, then release Emotional Overload on it. Repeat on an enemy that makes the save.
- **Expected:** Failed save: Psychic damage per feeling, the enemy dances for 1 turn, Mental Fatigue shows. Made save: half damage, no dance, Mental Fatigue shows. Either way the feelings are gone, Overloaded ends and the meter empties.
- **Fails if:** Paralysis, no Mental Fatigue, or the meter stays full.
- **Result:** —

### L1.6 · Charm-immune creatures don't dance

- **Rule:** V13 · R68
- **Steps:** Release Emotional Overload on an enemy immune to Charmed that fails the save.
- **Expected:** No dance. The feelings' damage and Mental Fatigue still land.
- **Fails if:** It dances.
- **Result:** —

### L1.7 · When a fight ends, the meter settles to half

- **Rule:** R53 · R53
- **Steps:** End one fight with the meter partly full (note the %). End another fight while Overloaded.
- **Expected:** After the first: about half the %. After the second: Overloaded is gone and the meter shows about 50%.
- **Fails if:** The meter keeps its value, empties, or Overloaded keeps going after the fight.
- **Result:** —

### L1.8 · Heartstring reads feelings

- **Rule:** R61 · R61
- **Steps:** Cast Heartstring on an enemy carrying one or two feelings.
- **Expected:** The cantrip damage plus 1d4 Psychic per feeling (combat log). The target's mood does not get longer.
- **Fails if:** No extra damage per feeling.
- **Result:** —

### L1.9 · Moods say what they react with

- **Rule:** R64 · R64
- **Steps:** Hover a mood on any creature (for example Serene).
- **Expected:** The tooltip lists what each emotion would make of it, with the level that unlocks it.
- **Fails if:** No list.
- **Result:** —

### L1.10 · Weave Surge in the deck

- **Rule:** V9 · R55
- **Steps:** Check the deck list (!arcanapool). Play a few fights.
- **Expected:** One Weave Surge card with 24 copies at level 5 (9 at level 1); no separate emotion cards; it is often in hand.
- **Fails if:** Eight emotion cards, 3 copies, or rarely in hand.
- **Edition:** PC
- **Result:** —

### L1.11 · Emotional Overload costs no Threads

- **Rule:** B4 · R66
- **Steps:** While Overloaded in combat, look at Emotional Overload's cost and cast it.
- **Expected:** 0 Threads.
- **Fails if:** It costs Threads.
- **Plan B:** Exclude it from the ARCANA_WEAVING check.
- **Edition:** PC
- **Result:** —

## Level 2 — Temper

**Setup:** The same Resonant at level 2.

### L2.1 · Temper and Anticipation at level 2

- **Rule:** L2a · R59
- **Steps:** Level up to 2.
- **Expected:** Temper is granted, and Anticipation opens inside Weave Surge.
- **Fails if:** Either arrives at level 3.
- **Result:** —

## Level 3 — Opposites, Tier I Resonance

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 3, one ally, fights long enough to wake Tier I.

### L3.1 · Nothing-to-do turns (levels 1-3)

- **Rule:** V4 · R51
- **Steps:** Over your fights at levels 1 to 3, count turns where the Resonant had nothing useful to do.
- **Expected:** None.
- **Fails if:** One or more per fight.
- **Kind:** observe
- **Result:** —

### L3.2 · Opposites and Tier I at level 3

- **Rule:** L3a · R60 R63
- **Steps:** Level up to 3. Pour Joy into a Pensive enemy. Wake Tier I in a fight and let a peak fade.
- **Expected:** The Opposites passive shows and Catharsis happens. With Tier I awake, Catharsis gets +1d8 and moods still last 5 turns (not 7).
- **Fails if:** No Opposites passive, or moods last 7 turns with Tier I.
- **Result:** —

## Level 5 — Deeper Feelings

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 5, a fight with several enemies and one ally.

### L5.1 · Temper's replay leaves no mood

- **Rule:** B1 · R49
- **Steps:** Land Disgust on an enemy and let it fade into Bored. Cast Temper on it (it fails the save). Wait until the replayed Disgust ends. Later, land a normal Disgust again and let it fade.
- **Expected:** After the Temper replay: no Bored. After the normal Disgust: Bored appears.
- **Fails if:** Bored comes back after the replay, or a normal Disgust stops leaving Bored.
- **Plan B:** The replay marker clears at the start of the Resonant's next turn instead.
- **Result:** —

### L5.2 · No Temper lock

- **Rule:** V2 · R49
- **Steps:** Right after B1, try to Temper the same enemy again on your next turn.
- **Expected:** Not possible: it has no mood until a new Disgust lands.
- **Fails if:** Temper locks it again with no new Surge.
- **Result:** —

### L5.3 · Emotional Overload, rank II

- **Rule:** R51d · R51 R66
- **Steps:** At level 5, fill the meter and release Emotional Overload.
- **Expected:** It takes two enemies.
- **Fails if:** Still one target.
- **Result:** —

### L5.4 · Overloaded grows at 5

- **Rule:** R52 · R52 R67
- **Steps:** At level 5, get Overloaded.
- **Expected:** 2d4 Psychic per turn and -2 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves; the rider deals 2d4.
- **Fails if:** Still 1d4 or -1.
- **Result:** —

### L5.5 · Deeper Feelings at 5

- **Rule:** R62a · R62
- **Steps:** Level up to 5. Land Fear on an enemy and let it fade into Apprehensive; have it make a Wisdom save.
- **Expected:** The Deeper Feelings passive shows. Apprehensive subtracts 1d6 (combat log).
- **Fails if:** No passive, or still 1d4.
- **Result:** —

### L5.6 · Does the dance's save discharge Mental Fatigue?

- **Rule:** B2 · R68
- **Steps:** At level 5+, release Emotional Overload on an enemy that fails: it dances and has Mental Fatigue (5+ turns). At its turn start it rolls a Wisdom save to stop dancing.
- **Expected:** Record what happens: if it fails that save, does it take 1d4 Psychic ('Psychic Discharge') and lose Mental Fatigue?
- **Fails if:** Nothing fails here: write down what you saw. The Owner decides.
- **Kind:** observe
- **Result:** —

## Level 6 — Complex Feelings

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 6, one lower-level ally, a normal fight.

### L6.1 · Complex Feelings at 6, not 5

- **Rule:** L6a · R59
- **Steps:** At level 5, pour Joy into an Apprehensive enemy. Level up to 6 and repeat.
- **Expected:** Level 5: a plain Joy peak. Level 6: Guilt.
- **Fails if:** Guilt at level 5.
- **Result:** —

### L6.2 · Growing dice read the Resonant's level

- **Rule:** B7 · R62
- **Steps:** At level 6, braid Hope on a lower-level ally and watch its next attack roll.
- **Expected:** Hope adds 1d6.
- **Fails if:** It adds 1d4 (the map reads the ally's level).
- **Plan B:** One status version per level band, chosen in the Surge.
- **Result:** —

## Level 7 — Overwhelm, Tier II Harmony

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 7 with Tier II reachable (6 reactions), one ally, a fight long enough to wake it.

### L7.1 · Excess once per fight

- **Rule:** V1 · R49 R50
- **Steps:** Joy on an ally, let it fade into Serene, Joy again: Ecstasy. Give it Serene again (a new Joy that fades) and pour Joy a third time. Do the same with Surprise on an enemy (Amazement).
- **Expected:** The second Ecstasy / Amazement on the same creature lands as a plain peak. When Ecstasy ends it leaves no mood.
- **Fails if:** The same creature gets Ecstasy or Amazement twice in one fight.
- **Result:** —

### L7.2 · Tier II's free Surge through the container

- **Rule:** B6b · R40 R54
- **Steps:** Wake Tier II. On your turn, cast an emotion through the Weave Surge container, then another one.
- **Expected:** The first costs no action and its mood shows at once; the second costs your action and can react with it.
- **Fails if:** The first Surge through the container costs an action.
- **Result:** —

### L7.3 · Ride or release (levels 3 and 7)

- **Rule:** V5 · R51
- **Steps:** Over a few fights, note whether you held Overloaded for a turn or two or released it at once.
- **Expected:** Sometimes held, sometimes released.
- **Fails if:** Always released at once, or never released.
- **Kind:** observe
- **Result:** —

## Level 9 — Deeper Feelings, Emotional Contagion, Mixed Feelings

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 9, a fight with a group of enemies close together and two allies.

### L9.1 · Emotional Overload, rank III (the area)

- **Rule:** B5 · R51 R67
- **Steps:** At level 9, release Emotional Overload on an enemy in a group.
- **Expected:** Every enemy within 9 m of the point rolls the save and takes its effect.
- **Fails if:** Only one or two targets.
- **Plan B:** A separate area spell for rank III, granted at level 9.
- **Result:** —

### L9.2 · Contagion + Tier II: no mass action loop

- **Rule:** V3 · R50
- **Steps:** Emotional Contagion on a Serene ally, wake Tier II, then pour Joy into the Serene allies each turn.
- **Expected:** Each ally gets at most one extra action (Ecstasy) per fight.
- **Fails if:** An ally gets Ecstasy on two turns.
- **Result:** —

### L9.3 · Growth at 9

- **Rule:** R62b · R62 R67
- **Steps:** Level up to 9. Check Hope on an ally, Overloaded and Catharsis.
- **Expected:** Deeper Feelings shows again. Hope 1d8; Overloaded 3d4 and -3; Catharsis 4d8.
- **Fails if:** The old values.
- **Result:** —

## Level 10 — Ready: Compassion

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 10, one ally, a normal fight.

### L10.1 · Compassion is kind

- **Rule:** V10a · R57
- **Steps:** At level 10, ready Compassion. Let an Apprehensive ally take damage from an enemy.
- **Expected:** Compassion casts Trust as a plain peak: no Submission, no Prone.
- **Fails if:** The ally is knocked Prone.
- **Result:** —

## Level 11 — Shared Heart

**Setup:** The Resonant at level 11, a long fight with the whole party.

### L11.1 · Shared Heart acts on cast

- **Rule:** R58 · R58
- **Steps:** Cast Shared Heart with the party within 18 m.
- **Expected:** Every linked creature feels Joy now and is Serene when it fades. The meter does not rise from it.
- **Fails if:** Nothing on cast, or the Overload fills from the Joy.
- **Result:** —

### L11.2 · Shared Heart shares only helpful feelings

- **Rule:** V10b · R57
- **Steps:** With the link up, braid Love on one ally, then braid a hindering feeling on another ally by hand.

# QA_ARC-0026 · The Windborn — rework WB0–WB50 (levels 1–12)

**Goal:** play every test, level by level, and mark it on Arcana Test Guides (https://claude.ai/artifact/3us5sESX9EbPDksY6H7W1E);
results come back here at `/sync-test-guides`. **Intent:** ARC-0026 is proven in the game, or each failure becomes a fix (bug) or
a decision (design feedback, OR-1). One file per ARC (OR-4): merged on 2026-10-17 from QA-0004, QA-0005, GUIDE_ARC-0026_probes, GUIDE_ARC-0026, TC_ARC-0022.

## Before you start

- Type the level from its part of TOOLKIT_ARC-0026.md (one file, a part per level), compile the Story (log.txt: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)) and tell Claude; then play that level's session here.
- Console edition (Script Extender off) unless a test says PC edition.
- A Windborn (Unbound subclass) character with no armour and no shield, unless a test says otherwise.
- The stage 1 probes (P1–P9) all passed on 2026-10-17; they are recorded in QA-0004.

## Probes — stage 1 (closed: 9/9 pass, QA-0004)

Before (this section): Stage 1 of ARC-0026 is applied (a [fechado] ARC-0026 message), the Story is compiled and log.txt shows 0 error(s), 0 warning(s). · Console edition: Script Extender off (the PC deck locks the probe spells in combat). · Load a save with the party; the probe spells ("Probe: ...") and the passive Probe Touch are added to every player character on load. · Any class and level. Probes are throwaway: stage 2 removes them. · Write down what you see for each probe, even when it fails: every probe has a plan B.

**Setup:** A fight with at least four enemies, spread out, and one ally in melee with an enemy. One character runs the probes.

### P1 · A Rush: no opportunity attack, paths around obstacles

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P1 (the Rush carries her, WB5)
- **Steps:** Stand next to an enemy. Cast Probe: Rush on another enemy 6-9 m away, behind a table or a corner if you can
- **Expected:** The character runs to the target and strikes it; the enemy she leaves makes no opportunity attack; she goes around the obstacle
- **Fails if:** An opportunity attack on the way, or the Rush stops at the obstacle or refuses the target behind it
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou.

### P2 · Marked enemies can't be rushed

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P2 (Rush only to an unmarked enemy)
- **Steps:** Cast Probe: Mark on one enemy. Open Probe: Rush and hover the marked enemy, then an unmarked one
- **Expected:** The marked enemy can't be targeted (greyed or refused); the unmarked one can
- **Fails if:** The marked enemy can be targeted
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou.

### P6 · A marked enemy makes no opportunity attack

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P6 (the Open Path, WB10: the vanilla Mobile pair)
- **Steps:** Cast Probe: Open Path. Mark the enemy next to your melee ally with Probe: Mark. On the ally's turn, walk away from it. Then do the same next to an unmarked enemy
- **Expected:** Marked: no opportunity attack. Unmarked: the usual opportunity attack
- **Fails if:** The marked enemy still attacks (plan B: a mark that blocks every reaction)
- **Result:** pass — Não funcionou. Porém, fiz uma alteração, criei um Interrupt IDENTICO ao próprio Interrupt_AttackOfOpportunity do vanilla e adicionei no EnableConditions "and not HasStatus('PROBE_ARC0026_MARK')" e agora funcionou perfeitamente, sempre que o inimigo estiver com esse status, ele não vai fazer ataque de oportunidade.

### P7 · A hit marks; an ally's hit marks in her name

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P7 (marks from hits — hers and an ally's)
- **Steps:** Hit an unmarked enemy with any attack (Probe Touch marks it). With Probe Open Path on you, let an ally hit another enemy
- **Expected:** Both enemies show Probe Windswept; the mark ticks down on your turns (2 of your turns)
- **Fails if:** No mark, the ally's hit does not mark, or the mark counts down on the enemy's turns
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou apenas para o ataque básico! Entretanto, fiz uma alteração, ao invés de OnAttack que é o padrão para ataques básicos, coloquei OnDamage, que é o padrão para qualquer tipo de dano, e ai coloquei TotalDamageDoneGreatherThan(0) para que os miss não contem.

### P8 · The bag's X: marks counted, capped at 2

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P8 (X counted and capped)
- **Steps:** Mark 3 enemies. Cast Probe: Count
- **Expected:** Probe Count appears on you showing 2 turns (3 marks, capped at 2); with 1 mark it shows 1 turn
- **Fails if:** No status, or the turns don't match the marks
- **Result:** pass — Agora funcionou como você esperado.

### P3 · Turn start sweeps the marks; turn end is seen

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P3 (the sweep at her turn start; her turn end)
- **Steps:** After P8, end your turn, then start your next turn
- **Expected:** At your turn end Probe Turn Ended shows on you; at your next turn start every Probe Windswept is gone
- **Fails if:** The marks stay, or Probe Turn Ended never shows
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou como o esperado.

### P4 · The vortex pulls marked enemies from 9 m, the others from 6 m, once each

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P4 (Where the Winds Meet, two radii)
- **Steps:** Mark one enemy about 8 m from a point; leave another unmarked 5 m from it and a third unmarked 8 m from it. Throw Probe: Vortex at the point
- **Expected:** The marked enemy at 8 m and the unmarked one at 5 m are pulled to the point and Off Balance, once each; the unmarked one at 8 m is not
- **Fails if:** An enemy pulled twice, the marked one not pulled, or the unmarked one at 8 m pulled (plan B: one 9 m pull for every enemy)
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou, mas eu mudei o jeito que a spell funciona. Ao invés de mudar a área, a área será sempre 9 metros, porém, inimigos com a marca são puxados 9m, e inimigos sem a marca são puxados 6m.

### P5 · Leap of Faith with the Force Tunnel animation

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P5 (Leap of Faith on the Force Tunnel animation, WB7)
- **Steps:** Cast Probe: Leap through a line of two enemies
- **Expected:** A dash-through animation (the Force Tunnel tadpole power), striking each enemy in the path
- **Fails if:** No animation, a broken pose, or it stops at the first enemy (plan B: keep the Spring Attack animation)
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou.

### P9 · Into the Storm: the push from a status

- **Rule:** SPEC_ARC-0026 P9 (a status pushes away from its source)
- **Steps:** Cast Probe: Storm Push on an enemy 3-6 m away
- **Expected:** The enemy is pushed about 3 m away from you and is Off Balance
- **Fails if:** No push, or pushed toward you or sideways (plan B: the goal casts a shove-like spell)
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou.

## Level 1 — The Open Road

**Setup:** A level-1 Windborn, no armour and no shield, in a fight with at least three enemies spread out and one ally in melee with an enemy.

### L1.1 · The class reads The Windborn; the preset and the AC are right

- **Rule:** WB43 · TC B12 (names)
- **Steps:** Create a Windborn at level 1 (or respec one). Look at the subclass name, the default abilities and the character sheet
- **Expected:** The subclass is The Windborn. The preset is STR 8, DEX 15, CON 13, INT 15, WIS 10, CHA 10. Armour Class = 10 + DEX + INT (Be the Leaf). Level-1 spells: Gale Burst only (no True Strike)
- **Fails if:** The old name Unbound anywhere, another preset, Wisdom in the AC, or True Strike in the list
- **Kind:** observe
- **Result:** —

### L1.2 · After an unarmed attack, Zephyr Rush carries you to an unmarked enemy

- **Rule:** WB5, WB18
- **Steps:** Hit an enemy with an unarmed attack. In the bonus actions, cast Zephyr Rush on an unmarked enemy 6–9 m away, past another enemy
- **Expected:** Zephyr Strike and Zephyr Rush both appear after the attack (and after a card). The Rush runs to the target and strikes it with no opportunity attack on the way. It needs no weapon and has no Short Rest cooldown
- **Fails if:** No Zephyr after the attack, an opportunity attack on the way, a weapon requirement, or a cooldown
- **Result:** FAIL — Funcionou mais ou menos. Acertei o inimigo com o ataque desarmado e apareceu o Zephyr Strike e o Zephyr Rush, entretanto o Zephyr Rush pode selecionar o chão, e na verdade só poderia ser possível selecionar um inimigo. E na verdade o Zephyr Rush ta com o mesmo nome do Zephyr Strike. O Zephyr Rush não está podendo selecionar o inimigo com Windswept, mas está podendo selecionar qualquer lugar no chão.

### L1.3 · The Rush only reaches an unmarked enemy within 9 m

- **Rule:** WB5 (range, target)
- **Steps:** Hover Zephyr Rush over a Windswept enemy, then over an unmarked one about 11 m away
- **Expected:** The Windswept enemy can't be targeted. At level 1 the 11 m enemy is out of range (9 m); Zephyr Strike still works on the marked one
- **Fails if:** The Rush can target a Windswept enemy, or reaches beyond 9 m
- **Result:** —

### L1.4 · Damage marks Windswept; a miss doesn't

- **Rule:** WB8, WB49 (P7)
- **Steps:** Hit one enemy with an unarmed attack, another with a card that deals damage, and miss a third
- **Expected:** Both enemies you damaged show Windswept; the missed one doesn't
- **Fails if:** No mark on damage, or a mark on a miss
- **Result:** pass — Funcionou.

### L1.5 · Gale Burst: a failed save marks; no free strike any more

- **Rule:** WB8, WB28
- **Steps:** Cast Gale Burst on an enemy (try until one fails and one succeeds)
- **Expected:** The enemy that fails is pushed, Prone and Windswept; the one that succeeds isn't marked. Gale Burst no longer gives a free unarmed strike, and its tooltip no longer says "Afterwards…"
- **Fails if:** A success marks, a failure doesn't, or the free strike is still there
- **Result:** note — Ai temos uma incoerência. A passiva OpenRoad faz com que sempre que cause dano no inimigo, ele recebe o Windswept. Então mesmo o inimigo tendo sucesso no teste do GaleBurst, ele ainda toma dano, consequentemente recebendo o Windswept.

### L1.6 · A Windswept enemy makes no opportunity attack

- **Rule:** WB10, WB49 (P6)
- **Steps:** Mark the enemy next to your melee ally. On the ally's turn, walk away from it. Do the same next to an unmarked enemy
- **Expected:** The marked enemy doesn't attack; the unmarked one makes its usual opportunity attack
- **Fails if:** The marked enemy attacks, or the unmarked one doesn't
